news.headline: Best week since April 2025, still the worst November since 2008
news.summary: The index bounced 5.6% this week yet sits on track for its worst November since 2008 with one session left and 6.7% still to recover from the 6 October record, while a December rate increase is nearly priced in — the year on this fund is being set by rates, not by its top five.
